turns.replyText:
Show me your two best value-for-money options and compare them.
Two of our strongest collections for overall value are Atmosphere and Ciello, each delivering great longevity and modular flexibility for different comfort preferences:
Atmosphere
Comfort & Seating: Deep, medium-firm seating using layered foam. It provides a balanced, supportive feel that works well for both structured sitting and relaxed lounging.
Maintenance & Durability: Layered foam maintains a consistent feel over time with minimal cushion fluffing required.
Long-Term Flexibility: Highly customizable modular layout. It allows for full cover changes, meaning you can replace or refresh all fabric covers down the road without replacing the entire sofa.
Ciello
Comfort & Seating: Plush, cloud-like sink-in comfort with loose foam-and-fiber cushions designed for relaxed lounging.
Maintenance & Durability: Requires regular fluffing (every one to two weeks) to keep the loose fill distributed. The base construction includes an added layer of D35 foam to enhance cushioning over the frame.
Long-Term Flexibility: Fully modular to expand or reconfigure over time. The Ciello (4.0) version also supports complete fabric cover changes.
The Trade-off
Choose Atmosphere if you want deep, medium-firm support, modern styling, and low cushion maintenance.
Choose Ciello if your priority is soft, sink-in lounging comfort and you don't mind routine cushion fluffing.
Both collections feature replaceable components and washable seat covers, allowing you to adapt or refresh modules over time rather than buying an entirely new sofa.
For the most accurate and up-to-date pricing on specific configurations, visit our website directly. You can also book a complimentary Design Consultation for personalized advice on your space.

turns.replyText:
Can I pay in installments or split payment?
Yes, you have options for both financing in installments and splitting payments:
Installments (Financing with Affirm)
We offer financing through Affirm at checkout for both Canada and the US:
Affirm Canada: APR ranges from 0% to 31.99% based on creditworthiness and provincial regulations (not all customers qualify for 0% APR). Payment plans are subject to an eligibility check, and a down payment may be required. Options may include bi-weekly or monthly payment schedules. Repayment is accepted via debit card, Pre-Authorized Debit (PAD), and select credit cards. More details are available at the Affirm Help Center.
Affirm US: APR ranges from 0% to 36% depending on eligibility and lender terms, subject to an eligibility check and purchase amount. Loans in California are provided by Affirm Loan Services, LLC under the California Finance Lenders Law license (affirm.com/licenses). Additional lender details can be reviewed at affirm.com/lenders.
If you choose to add CozeyProtection+, it can also be financed right along with your furniture, as financing applies to the total cart value.
Splitting Payment Over Two Cards
Our checkout system does not directly split a single order across two cards. However, because our sofas are modular, an alternative option is to create multiple orders containing different parts of the sofa on separate cards. Keep in mind that placing separate orders means the boxes might not be delivered at the same time.
